text: Pactspirits will change Pact Point effects. One Pactspirit can follow you around and automatically loot some items.
Pactspirit installation will change the effects of Pact Nodes in the current area: You can switch to the original Pact Nodes anytime.
Pactspirits of different rarity can cause different scopes of change. Legendary Pactspirits will change all the Pact Nodes in the area.
Pactspirits that are not installed can follow you around in the scene but can only automatically loot some drops.
1. Pactspirits come in two main types: Battle Pactspirits and Drop Pactspirits, and 3 of each type can be installed.
2. Installed Battle Pactspirits have their own exclusive Pact Pages.
3. Installed Rare Pactspirits can unlock Pact Points in advance.
4. No allocations are required for Drop Pactspirits as all their Talent Node effects are activated upon installation.
5. Any Pactspirit, installed or not, can be selected to follow you and automatically pick up some loot.
1. Destinies can be installed in Talent Nodes where you've already allocated points in the Pact Page to replace the original effects of the Talent Nodes.
2. Installing a Destiny doesn't cost anything. When removing a Destiny, it is possible to select 2 different types of materials, each yielding a different outcome.

3. Destinies are divided into Micro and Medium Destinies, and each type of Destiny has a separate installation quantity limit, which is gradually unlocked by completing specific quests. Refer to [Installation Limit] on the right side of the Pact Page for details.

4. Undetermined Fates are installed in Undetermined Fate Slots, granting a number of additional Destiny Slots that do not count toward the installation limit of Destinies. Undetermined Fates do not count toward the total number of installed Destinies.
